what_happened: Scene: white kettle with a black arched handle on the counter right of a gas hob (black pot on the hob); same layout as s2/s26. Attempt 1: the gripper came down over the kettle 124-136, with the handle lying horizontally across the wrist image (along the finger-closing axis). At 140-144 the fingers appear closed below the handle without catching it (no contact registered), and by 148-152 the gripper rose and left. The policy then acted as if it held the kettle. 176-336 it went over the hob beside the pot, rose high and looked into the pot. 360-560 it hovered low over the left and front-left burner grates with an empty gripper (place-like motion), then swung back right 600-720. Attempt 2: 808-840 it came down again with the wrist rotated, so the handle was roughly upright but to the right of the finger gap. It touched the kettle 824-835 (hold 830-836, lift 0) and did not lift it. 856-1000 it hovered 20-30 cm above the kettle. The kettle moved 0.3 cm, and no knob was touched.
causal_chain: handle across the closing axis at first approach (124-136) -> closed on air ~140 -> ~400 steps of empty-handed 'place' over the hob (176-560) -> back at the kettle ~720, second miss 824-836 (lift 0) -> hovered to timeout; stage 0 never complete
self_recovery: One re-attempt at 808-836, about 670 steps later, with the wrist re-oriented. It touched the kettle for 12 steps but did not lift it. Failed.
official_criterion_notes: The first miss (~140) does not appear in the packet: no gripper touch is registered, and min_eef 0.04 m comes from attempt 2. From gripper_touch_intervals alone the first 800 steps look like they had no grasp attempt.
uncertain_about: 'Closed on air at ~140' is inferred from wrist frames 140-144 (fingers look closed with the handle above them); the packet registers no contact then. Sequence of events after that: high confidence.
